name: All Four Together
tagline: All 4 fly PHL → Orlando Thu 5:15 AM (Frontier, booked), Magic Kingdom Thu, Epcot + parade Fri (2 hotel nights), Nicole's Sat, Southwest TPA → PHL Sun (booked) — the car waits at PHL
vibe: Re-plan after all four decided to travel together (2026-10-19). The Wednesday-night Newark JetBlue fare jumped to $851/seat for four, so the cheapest way down is Thursday morning from PHL, parking the car there for 4 days and coming home to it on the Southwest flight that uses the $500 Sapphire credit. Wednesday-night Newark options stay on the flight cards for comparison (see the ✈ Flights tab scenarios).
highlights: One car, parked at PHL Economy ($18/day) — no drop-offs or pickups
MBG parade at Epcot — Fri 10:05 AM
Two nights near the parks (Holiday Inn Resort LBV, $250 IHG credit)
Southwest home Sunday ($500 Sapphire Southwest credit)

days.label: Day 1 — Wednesday, Nov 4
days.theme: Band bus leaves · regular workday (Jaquan in New Brunswick until 5) · pack, early night

segments.activity: Thandi drops luggage at CHS band room; MBG buses depart (time TBD)
Pack carry-ons (Frontier Economy bundle = 1 carry-on + personal item each), print/load boarding passes, bed by 9:30

days.notes: No Wednesday travel: the only Wednesday-evening flights that fit a 5 PM New Brunswick finish leave Newark, and for four they now cost $2,117 (United → Tampa) to $3,402 (JetBlue → Orlando).

days.label: Day 2 — Thursday, Nov 5
days.theme: Fly PHL → Orlando 5:15 AM (booked) · Magic Kingdom from ~9:30 · check in near the parks

legs.notes: Leave home ~3:15 AM → PHL Economy Lot (shuttle to terminals) by ~4:00; park Thu–Sun, ~$72 (4 × $18).
BOOKED: Frontier F9 2415 5:15 AM → 8:01 AM, confirmation in email/calendar, $947.92 for 4 (Economy bundles). Seats 24A, 25A–C.
Pick up the one-way rental (MCO → TPA Sun) and drive to the Transportation & Ticket Center; or drop bags at the hotel first.

segments.activity: Leave home → PHL Economy Lot
Frontier F9 2415 PHL → Orlando nonstop (lands 8:01 AM) — conf. in calendar
Rental car, drive to Magic Kingdom (bags stay in the trunk until hotel check-in)
Enter; first Multi Pass window. Seven Dwarfs Mine Train → Peter Pan's Flight → Haunted Mansion
segments.notes: Multi Pass picks for today: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Jungle Cruise, Peter Pan's Flight. Book 3 days out (Mon Nov 2, 7 AM ET). Plan a mid-afternoon rest — everyone was up at 3 AM.

segments.activity: Lunch — Columbia Harbour House (indoor, seated, Liberty Square)
Cool-down block: PeopleMover → Monsters, Inc. Laugh Floor (live improv, seated, cold) → Mickey's PhilharMagic if you still need AC
segments.notes: Skipping Carousel of Progress and Hall of Presidents — museum-grade exhibits (2 of 5 on the scorecard). If the hotel is already checked in, the pool works too, but the drive out and back costs ~1 hr.

segments.activity: Pirates of the Caribbean → Jungle Cruise (Multi Pass) → Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin (Toy Story)
segments.notes: Kid's call: Big Thunder Mountain (fast, no inversions, shaky). Skip Space Mountain and Tron for motion sickness unless someone volunteers.

segments.activity: Dinner — Pecos Bill or Cosmic Ray's; walk Main Street while it's lit
Happily Ever After fireworks from Main Street (confirm time on the app — 8 or 9 PM)
segments.notes: Wait 20 min in the Emporium after the show before heading to the monorail/ferry — the exit crush is real.

segments.activity: Drive to the hotel, check in (2 nights, Thu–Sat)

days.notes: Early start (3:15 AM) bought a near-full Magic Kingdom day and saved ~$190 vs the 7:35 AM.

days.label: Day 3 — Friday, Nov 6
days.theme: EPCOT — parade at 10:05, World Showcase lap, stay for Luminous (no early morning tomorrow)

legs.notes: Or the Skyliner to International Gateway if staying at Pop Century / Art of Animation / Caribbean Beach — it lands beside the UK pavilion.
4th traveler: Frontier PHL 5:15 AM → MCO 8:01 AM ($129). Only flight that makes the parade. Leave home ~2:45 AM.
Rideshare straight to Epcot (~$40–50). Tight but doable for 10:05.

segments.activity: Drive (or hotel shuttle) to Epcot — all four together, no airport run
Gate. Walk straight to World Showcase and stake out a parade spot (UK/Canada end = step-off; American Adventure = finish). Pavilions open at 11, so this stretch is only for the spot.
MBG PARADE — steps off in the UK pavilion, ends at the American Adventure
Frozen Ever After (Norway, Multi Pass) → Remy's Ratatouille Adventure (France) — both open before World Showcase
segments.notes: Multi Pass picks for today: Frozen Ever After, Remy, Soarin'. Guardians of the Galaxy (Marvel) is Single Pass only and the worst motion-sickness ride on property — skip or one brave rider.

segments.activity: World Showcase lap, counter-clockwise from Norway: Mexico (Gran Fiesta boat if there's no line), Norway, China (acrobats if performing — skip the film), Germany (Karamell-Küche, train village), Italy
segments.notes: Grab a Food & Wine Festival passport at the entrance — stamp the Global Marketplace booths as you go. Lunch = $5–10 festival plates along the way (budget ~$60–80 for four). Skip the pavilion films (Canada/China/France) and The Seas with Nemo — museum-grade or built for small kids.

segments.activity: The American Adventure show (30 min, seated, air-conditioned) — the built-in rest
Japan (Mitsukoshi store, Kabuki Cafe shaved ice) → Morocco alleys → France (Beauty and the Beast Sing-Along, bakery) → UK → Canada

Back to World Celebration: Soarin' (Multi Pass) → Mission: SPACE green side (mild, no spin) → Club Cool (free world Coke flavors) → Spaceship Earth if there's time. Test Track is the kids' call (fast, no inversions).
Dinner from the winning booth, then Luminous fireworks at 9 PM — no rope drop tomorrow, so stay as late as the kids last

days.notes: Food & Wine Festival runs Aug 27 – Nov 21, so the booths are up. Everyone watching the parade needs Epcot admission today. Last park day of the trip: if anyone wants Hollywood Studios, a Park Hopper on today's ticket is the only way (Skyliner from the International Gateway, ~15 min).

days.label: Day 4 — Saturday, Nov 7
days.theme: Check out · drive to Nicole's · Tampa afternoon (band workshop at Epcot)

legs.notes: , late morning — no park today, so no rush. From Land O' Lakes: ~95 mi, 1h40 (2h in traffic) via I-75 S → I-4 E.

segments.activity: MBG soundtrack workshop at Epcot (Thandi, students only) — the band stays in the parks afterward
Sleep in, pool, check out by 11 — bags in the car. Optional Disney Springs stop on the way out (free parking, no ticket)
Drive to Tampa (1h30)
Arrive at Nicole's — Land O' Lakes (Nicole's) afternoon (Riverwalk, Armature Works, or just the pool)
Early dinner, early night — 4:45 AM alarm for the 7:16 flight (or sleep in for the 12:59 PM option)

days.notes: Giving up Saturday's park day is what makes Sunday's Tampa flight work: Sunday nonstops from Orlando are $726+ per person, while Tampa has a $218 nonstop at 7:16 AM. Hollywood Studios drops out of the trip unless Thursday swaps to it.

days.label: Day 5 — Sunday, Nov 8
days.theme: Fly home TPA → PHL (Southwest 6:15 AM via St. Louis) · drive home from PHL · band buses leave tonight

legs.notes: Leave Nicole's by 4:45 AM, return the rental at TPA, at the gate by 6:15. Land O' Lakes → TPA is ~25 mi / 35 min (Veterans Expy / Suncoast Pkwy).
Frontier nonstop 7:16 AM → 9:54 AM, 4 tickets $872. Alternative: Frontier via Atlanta 12:59 PM → 6:19 PM, $1,338 for 4, no 4:45 AM alarm.

segments.activity: Leave Nicole's for TPA, drop the rental
Southwest WN 4283 TPA 6:15 AM → St. Louis 7:40 AM CT; WN 4922 STL 10:40 AM CT → PHL 1:50 PM ET — conf. in calendar (Choice, choose seats on southwest.com)
Economy Lot shuttle → car → home by ~3:30 PM
MBG loads buses and departs Orlando for NJ (Thandi); bus reaches CHS Monday, time via Band app

days.notes: Home a day earlier than the Family Plan and Thandi is on the bus until Monday either way. If the 4:45 AM start is a dealbreaker, the 12:59 PM Atlanta connection costs $466 more for the four of us.
